evidence: Labeled `Utils/log/libs`; restructures `ECC_Context` and hooks Bitcoin Core's hardware-accelerated SHA256 compression into libsecp256k1 context callbacks in `src/crypto/` and `src/common/`.
rationale: Plugs hardware SHA-NI/ARMv8 SHA256 acceleration into libsecp256k1 signing contexts, giving a modest 7–15% speedup to ECDSA and Schnorr signing. While a welcome improvement to cryptographic primitives that enables future use in BIP352 and MuSig, signing is rarely a bottleneck for node operation and verification performance is essentially unchanged.
